title: Hedge funds hold $2 trillion in US debt, but their next trade could require fewer bonds
summary: Hedge funds held an estimated $2 trillion in cash US Treasuries at the end of 2025, or about 7% of the marketable debt outstanding, according to the Office of Financial Research.
